name: AIOPS-SLO-001 booking-api-availability
service: AI Operations Platform booking API (synthetic MVP)
user_journey: Business owner or assistant-approved action books, moves or cancels a customer booking

sli.description: Proportion of valid booking API requests served successfully
sli.good_events: HTTP responses with status < 500 and latency below 2 s, excluding 429 from per-tenant rate limiting
sli.valid_events: All booking API requests from authenticated tenants, excluding synthetic health checks and the LLM drafting endpoints (separate SLO later)
sli.measurement: Load balancer request logs aggregated per minute

exclusion_policy: Planned maintenance announced 7 days ahead and capped at 30 minutes per month
error_budget_policy: If the 30-day budget is exhausted, assistant feature releases pause until reliability work restores budget; exceptions need the product owner and reliability lead
